name: Grayanotoxin
summary: Grayanotoxin is a depressant substance belonging to the Diterpene chemical class.

pharmacology.text: Grayanotoxins are a group of toxic diterpenes found in the ericacaeae family of plants. More than 25 grayanotoxin isoforms have been isolated from rhododendron, though grayanotoxin I and grayanotoxin III are considered to be the most responsible for the toxic pharmacological effects of grayanotoxin-containing plants. Grayanotoxin I, as well as grayanotoxin III, act as agonists of voltage-gated sodium channels.

uses.en: It has no medical use. Mad honey containing it is eaten in small amounts in parts of Turkey and Nepal as a folk remedy and for its effects.
uses.zh: 它沒有醫療用途。含有它的瘋蜜在土耳其和尼泊爾部分地區被少量食用，作為民間療法或為了其作用。
uses.zhHans: 它没有医疗用途。含有它的疯蜜在土耳其和尼泊尔部分地区被少量食用，作为民间疗法或为了其作用。

sideEffects.en: It holds sodium channels in nerves and heart muscle open, which can cause dizziness, sweating, nausea, vomiting, blurred vision, a very slow heartbeat, low blood pressure and fainting. Severe poisoning can cause dangerous heart rhythm problems.
sideEffects.zh: 它會讓神經和心肌的鈉離子通道保持開啟，可能造成頭暈、冒汗、噁心、嘔吐、視線模糊、心跳極慢、低血壓和昏厥。嚴重中毒可能導致危險的心律問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会让神经和心肌的钠离子信道保持打开，可能造成头晕、冒汗、恶心、呕吐、视线模糊、心跳极慢、低血压和昏厥。严重中毒可能导致危险的心律问题。

fact.en: Grayanotoxins from rhododendron nectar make mad honey. The Greek writer Xenophon described soldiers who ate honey near the Black Sea in 401 BC falling ill as if drunk.
fact.zh: 杜鵑花蜜中的木藜蘆毒素會形成「瘋蜜」。古希臘作家色諾芬記載，西元前 401 年士兵在黑海附近吃了蜂蜜後病倒，看起來就像喝醉一樣。
fact.zhHans: 杜鹃花蜜中的木藜芦毒素会形成「疯蜜」。古希腊作家色诺芬记载，西元前 401 年士兵在黑海附近吃了蜂蜜后病倒，看起来就像喝醉一样。
